newsitem.title: ITALY: Deaths still outstrip births in Italy in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Deaths still outstrip births in Italy in 1996.

text.p: The number of births in Italy in 1996 was lower than the number of deaths for the fourth year in a row, according to figures released on Wednesday by the national statistics agency Istat.
Istat said 536,740 people were born in 1996, while 557,756 died. The number of births was up two percent compared with 1995 while the number of deaths rose 0.5 percent.
Istat said Italy's population at the end of 1996 was 57,460,977.
